candidates.text: Margaery leaves her escort behind to walk into a poor district of King's Landing and hand food to orphans.
candidates.grounded_in: Margaery Tyrell engages in charitable acts with King's Landing orphans.

candidates.text: Ros takes Shae aside for a quiet word, warning her that Littlefinger is not to be trusted.
candidates.grounded_in: Ros warns Shae to distrust Littlefinger.

candidates.text: A scarred Tyrion sits across from his father in his chambers, pressing his claim to Casterly Rock.
candidates.grounded_in: A scarred Tyrion Lannister attempts to negotiate Casterly Rock from Tywin

candidates.text: Daenerys arrives by ship at Astapor, where ranks of slave soldiers stand motionless while a slaver talks terms.
candidates.grounded_in: Daenerys Targaryen arrives in Astapor to buy an army of brutally-trained mercenary soldiers called the "Unsullied"

candidates.text: Jon is marched through the sprawling wildling camp and brought before Mance Rayder inside his tent.
candidates.grounded_in: Jon is brought before Mance Rayder, the "King beyond the Wall"

2.title: Dark Wings, Dark Words

candidates.text: In a garden, Margaery and her sharp-tongued grandmother press Sansa with questions about Joffrey and invite her to Highgarden.
candidates.grounded_in: Margaery and her grandmother Olenna, the "Queen of Thorns", question Sansa about Joffrey's troubling personality and suggest that she visit Highgarden.

candidates.text: Trudging through the woods with Osha and Hodor, Bran's party comes across a strange brother and sister travelling alone.
candidates.grounded_in: Bran, Rickon, Osha, and Hodor encounter siblings Jojen and Meera Reed

candidates.text: Still on foot in open country, Arya, Gendry and Hot Pie are making their way toward Riverrun.
candidates.grounded_in: Arya Stark, Gendry and Hot Pie also make for Riverrun

candidates.text: One of Robb's northern bannermen rages at him openly over the freeing of Jaime Lannister.
candidates.grounded_in: his bannerman Lord Rickard Karstark is furious at the release of Jaime

2.note: The episode's strongest images (the Jaime–Brienne roadside fight, the inn) are framed in the summary as leading directly to captures and an identity reveal, so I left them out.

3.title: Walk of Punishment

candidates.text: Hot Pie is left behind at the inn to work there, while the others are taken onward.
candidates.grounded_in: Hot Pie is allowed to remain behind to work at the inn

candidates.text: Tywin hands Tyrion the crown's purse, naming his son the new Master of Coin.
candidates.grounded_in: appoints Tyrion as the new Master of Coin

candidates.text: Tywin instructs Littlefinger to travel to the Eyrie and win Lysa Arryn's hand and allegiance.
candidates.grounded_in: Tywin Lannister sends Littlefinger to the Eyrie to marry Lysa Arryn to secure her allegiance

candidates.text: Mance orders Jon to join a wildling band climbing the Wall to strike Castle Black from behind.
candidates.grounded_in: Mance Rayder sends Jon and a band of Wildlings led by Tormund Giantsbane to scale the Wall

candidates.text: The surviving Night's Watch men trudge back to Craster's Keep, where Gilly is giving birth.
candidates.grounded_in: The surviving Night's Watch men return to Craster's Keep, where Gilly gives birth to a son

3.note: Avoided the Riverrun funeral (a death), Jaime's hand, and the dragon-for-Unsullied bargain, which the summary frames as setup for the next episode's turn.

4.title: And Now His Watch Is Ended

candidates.text: Varys tells Tyrion the story of how he was cut as a boy, then shows him a crated captive in his chambers.
candidates.grounded_in: Varys tells Tyrion how he became a eunuch, then shows him the sorcerer who castrated him, who is now his captive

candidates.text: Arya and Gendry are brought into the Brotherhood's hidden cave and led before the outlaws' leader.
candidates.grounded_in: Arya and Gendry are taken to the Brotherhood's secret cave, meeting their leader

candidates.text: Brienne, still bound alongside a despairing Jaime, urges him to keep hoping rather than give up.
candidates.grounded_in: Brienne urges him to remain hopeful

4.note: Most of this episode's material is turning-point stuff (Craster's Keep, Astapor, Theon), so the safe texture is limited.

candidates.text: Stannis's young daughter sneaks down to the cells with a book and begins teaching Davos his letters.
candidates.grounded_in: Their daughter, Princess Shireen, sneaks into the dungeon to visit Davos and teaches him to read.

candidates.text: Tyrion, buried in the crown's accounts, haggles with Olenna over who should pay for half the royal wedding.
candidates.grounded_in: Tyrion, knowing the Crown is deeply in debt to the Iron Bank, persuades Olenna to pay for half of the royal wedding.

candidates.text: Daenerys tells the assembled Unsullied to pick a commander from among their own ranks rather than have one appointed.
candidates.grounded_in: Daenerys encourages the Unsullied to choose a leader among them

candidates.text: At Harrenhal, a disgraced former maester unwraps and tends the bandaged stump at the end of Jaime's arm.
candidates.grounded_in: having his stump treated by the disgraced former maester Qyburn
